ns2:course.label: Knowledge Representation
ns2:course.description: Surveys theories and data about the representation of knowledge by human beings; examines images, concepts, semantic features, propositions, semantic nets, rules, parallel distributed, procedural, schemas, mental models, and theories. Prerequisite: Background in either cognitive psychology, linguistics, or artificial intelligence.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Background in either cognitive psychology, linguistics, or artificial intelligence.
